## Fixed

- Vertically center taskbar captions with the application icon and the visible button, including when the bottom edge has an enlarged click target.
- Align text to the screen’s backing pixels using native AppKit behavior, preserving crisp rendering on 1x and 2x displays, including color emoji and fallback glyphs.

## Verification

The complete test suite, constrained-executor checks, tooling, localization, deployment checks, Apple Silicon Release build and WindowLab replays pass. Independent offscreen raster regressions compare captions against a standard AppKit Auto Layout centerY reference at real 1x and 2x backing scales in both appearances. These regressions fail on the previous implementation.
